description: Free, open source, cross-platform audio software for multi-track recording and editing (legacy version)
notes: Mirrored via the Internet Archive's 'Audacity Archive Up to Version 2.4.2' collection (archive.org/details/AudacityArchive), which the uploader states was obtained directly from FossHub/Google Code/Audacity's GitHub and left untouched. This avoids FossHub's expiring genLink download URLs, which are not stable enough for a scoop manifest. Before relying on this manifest, verify the hash yourself once with 'scoop install' or 'certutil -hashfile audacity-win-2.4.1.exe SHA256' -- it should match dde069264974b3bf7a0b556ea3037bb424630e3112735f99129f3d84921e547f, the SHA256 published on Audacity's own support site (support.audacityteam.org). Source code for GPL compliance: https://github.com/audacity/audacity/releases/tag/Audacity-2.4.1 (source zip/tar.xz assets). install-association.reg / uninstall-association.reg are written next to audacity.exe (not auto-applied); double-click install-association.reg to register Audacity in the Windows 'Open with' / Default apps picker under HKCU, and uninstall-association.reg to remove it.
post_install:
$installAssociation = @"
Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\Applications\audacity.exe]
"FriendlyAppName"="Audacity"

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\Applications\audacity.exe\shell\open\command]
@="\"$exe\" \"%1\""

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\Applications\audacity.exe\SupportedTypes]
".aup"=""
".wav"=""
".mp3"=""
".ogg"=""
".flac"=""
".aiff"=""
".au"=""

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\Applications\audacity.exe\Capabilities]
"ApplicationName"="Audacity"
"ApplicationDescription"="Free, open source, cross-platform audio editor"

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\Applications\audacity.exe\Capabilities\FileAssociations]
".aup"="Applications\\audacity.exe"
".wav"="Applications\\audacity.exe"
".mp3"="Applications\\audacity.exe"
".ogg"="Applications\\audacity.exe"
".flac"="Applications\\audacity.exe"
".aiff"="Applications\\audacity.exe"
".au"="Applications\\audacity.exe"

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\RegisteredApplications]
"Audacity"="Software\\Classes\\Applications\\audacity.exe\\Capabilities"
"@
Set-Content -Path "$dir\install-association.reg" -Value $installAssociation -Encoding Unicode

$uninstallAssociation = @"
Windows Registry Editor Version 5.00

[HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\RegisteredApplications]
"Audacity"=-

[-HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\Applications\audacity.exe]
"@
Set-Content -Path "$dir\uninstall-association.reg" -Value $uninstallAssociation -Encoding Unicode
